subject: SOC2 findings status summary and remediation commitments — interim assurance plan
body:
From: Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@finsight.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 6, 2027 at 9:12 AM -0700
Subject: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II finding — privileged access review gap

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this on. During our SOC 2 Type II review for the period ending Apr 30, 2027, our auditors flagged a control exception related to periodic privileged-access reviews (control CC-AP-04). They noted a gap in the evidence for the April cycle and asked for: (1) management response that describes the root cause, (2) remediation activities already completed or in-progress, and (3) supporting artifacts (audit logs, change tickets, and a roster of accounts reviewed).

We also need to understand whether Redwood can provide an interim assurance document (equivalent to a bridge letter) that covers the audit window May 1–31, 2027 while the permanent remediation is validated. If you can, please provide:
- A short status summary of the finding and immediate mitigations
- Target remediation dates and owners
- A consolidated evidence bundle or secure share link

Preferred delivery: a secure zipped package or a Google Drive folder with an index file. Let me know if you need an approved format for auditor consumption.

We appreciate a response by EOD Monday, May 10, since our audit team needs to finalize their report draft.

Thanks,
Dana Brooks
Senior Security Analyst
FinSight

---

On Thu, May 6, 2027 at 1:45 PM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@finsight.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 6, 2027 at 13:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II finding — privileged access review gap

Hi Dana — thanks for the clear ask and the deadline.

Short version / plan: we acknowledge the exception and have started remediation. Attached is an interim remediation plan (interim_remediation_plan_v1.pdf) and an evidence index that maps artifacts to the auditor's requests (evidence_index.csv). Highlights:
- Root cause: a scheduled report failed to include recently onboarded admin accounts due to a sync job timing issue (logs attached).
- Immediate mitigations (completed 05/06): forced reconciliation of account groups, enforcement of MFA for elevated accounts, temporary additional manual review for April/May cycles.
- Remediation path: fix sync job, add alerting, and add an automated reconciliation test that runs daily.

Owners and preliminary dates:
- Fix cron/sync job: Marcus Lin — targeted 2027-05-08 (in progress).
- Automated reconciliation test: Engineering (Marcus) — targeted 2027-05-14.
- Formalized audit evidence package and interim assurance memo: Compliance (Grace O'Connor) — targeted deliverable 2027-05-10.

We will provide a single secure zip with the artifacts you requested (privileged-access-logs-202704.zip) plus the interim assurance memo. If your auditors prefer a signed PDF bridge-style note, Grace can produce a short management affirmation with scope and dates. Which format would be preferable for your team?

Attachments: interim_remediation_plan_v1.pdf (plan, owners, timeline), evidence_index.csv (artifact index).

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Risk & Compliance
Redwood Inference

---

On Sat, May 8, 2027 at 10:30 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@finsight.com>
Date: Sat, May 8, 2027 at 10:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II finding — privileged access review gap

Quick technical update for the thread and for Dana's auditors:
- Root cause confirmed: a database paging bug in the onboarding_sync worker resulted in ~18 elevated accounts not being included in the April reconciliation export.
- Fix deployed (hotfix) 2027-05-07 02:10 UTC: paging logic corrected and added unit test.
- Evidence prepared: 
  * change ticket: JIRA-1764 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-1764) — describes the bug and code diff.
  * deploy logs: deploy_20270507_0210.log (included in privileged-access-logs-202704.zip)
  * reconciliation run results: recon_results_20270507.csv (in zip)
- Next steps: add monitoring alert (ETA 2027-05-12) and create a daily reconciliation smoke test (ETA 2027-05-14).

If auditors need raw DB query extracts instead of recon CSVs, flag it and I can pull them under secure transfer.

-Marcus
Senior Software Engineer
Redwood Inference

---

On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 4:20 PM Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@finsight.com> wrote:
From: Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@finsight.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, May 10, 2027 at 16:20 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II finding — privileged access review gap

Stephanie — thanks for the rapid turnaround and for the artifacts. We received the zip and the index file. A few quick clarifications from our audit team:
- They prefer a concise management affirmation that mirrors a traditional bridge letter (signed PDF) covering the audit window May 1–31, 2027. The content should state scope, what was remediated vs. in-progress, and confirm whether temporary compensating controls remain in place.
- They may request DB extracts if they cannot reconcile CSVs to the logs; please confirm availability and the mechanism for secure transfer.

Action items for Redwood:
1) Grace to prepare a 1-page signed interim management affirmation (due 2027-05-11 EOD).
2) Marcus to confirm availability of DB extracts and method (SFTP or secure link) by 2027-05-11 EOD.
3) Stephanie to confirm that the interim remediation plan and artifacts are final for auditor review (reply here).

If you can meet those timelines we'll be able to keep the audit report on schedule. Appreciate the quick work.

Best regards,
Dana Brooks
Senior Security Analyst
FinSight

---

[Attachments referenced in thread: interim_remediation_plan_v1.pdf (plan), evidence_index.csv (artifact map), privileged-access-logs-202704.zip (logs + recon CSV + deploy logs)]
